probe: Use the existing focused lifecycle tests or a fixed dataset/map/route replay in a task-owned output directory.
success: Preserve Product/env/RunPlan ownership; verify the requested startup or native 3D map/save/reload/planner behavior against the original checks.
boundaries: Keep local tests, simulation, field no-motion, and field motion evidence distinct. Do not deploy or issue motion as candidate probes. Follow the project anti-overdefense rules.
refresh: Read the latest user request, task artifacts and applicable instructions before each experiment. This profile does not authorize live actions or replace the current task owner.
budget: Normally one baseline and one candidate, using the active task budget; preserve existing Ralph/OMX state.
